values.en: For an arc-length parametrized curve $\gamma$ with $\gamma''\neq 0$, the **binormal vector** is $\mathbf{b}:=\mathbf{t}\wedge\mathbf{n}$, i.e. $\mathbf{b}(s)=\mathbf{t}(s)\wedge\mathbf{n}(s)$: the cross product of the unit tangent vector and the principal normal vector. As the cross product of two orthogonal unit vectors it is again a unit vector, and $\mathbf{t},\mathbf{n},\mathbf{b}$ form a right-handed orthonormal frame along the curve. Geometrically $\mathbf{b}$ is the unit normal of the osculating plane, the plane spanned by $\mathbf{t}$ and $\mathbf{n}$.
values.zh-CN: 对满足 $\gamma''\neq 0$ 的以弧长为参数的曲线 $\gamma$，**副法向量**定义为 $\mathbf{b}:=\mathbf{t}\wedge\mathbf{n}$，即 $\mathbf{b}(s)=\mathbf{t}(s)\wedge\mathbf{n}(s)$，也就是单位切向量与主法向量的叉积。两个正交单位向量的叉积仍为单位向量，故 $\mathbf{t},\mathbf{n},\mathbf{b}$ 沿曲线构成右手正交标架。几何上 $\mathbf{b}$ 是由 $\mathbf{t}$ 与 $\mathbf{n}$ 张成的密切平面的单位法向量。
